This works nicely. After I hit "Get page details," it filled in the title and description and paused so I could look them over, and I could type right over them. My saved item now reads "My go-to crispy roast potatoes" with "Make these for Sunday dinner." underneath, and it still opens the real Serious Eats page. That's exactly right.

The pause feels good to me, not annoying — it's the natural moment to fix an ugly auto-title before it lands in my collection, and I can just leave it alone and save if the details are already fine.

Now the other half of what I asked about: editing a bookmark *later*, after it's already sitting in my collection. Sometimes I only realize weeks later that a title is confusing. Can you show me changing the title or description of one that's already saved?
